content.content:
pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, hence the same
            computed householdId); the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it, a second owner in an
            existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409). Optional; defaults to
            false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's
                normalized telephone followed by the last name. Assigned at creation
                time; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
                Derived from the owner's own fields at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized last name and the postcode joined by '|'. Every owner that
                shares a last name and postcode therefore carries the same value, with
                no opt-in required. Null for owners created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3, computed at
                creation time: it starts at 1, gains 1 when the owner has an email
                address, gains 1 when the owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), and
                is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the customer code: its '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one was flagged a possible duplicate
                of; null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection, formatted '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>
                |<householdId or empty>'. A new owner is rejected as a duplicate only
                when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in the owner's customer code. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as it stands on the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when the owner has no birth date.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

                creation time: it starts at 1, gains 1 when the owner has an email
                address, gains 1 when the owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), and

              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true

          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must

          maxLength: 20

          title: Email address

          type: string

          title: Registration date

          type: string
          format: date

        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-

            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-

            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'

          title: Shares household
          description: >-

            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, hence the same
            computed householdId); the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it, a second owner in an
            existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409). Optional; defaults to
            false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

              title: Initials
              description: >-

              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION

                postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first eight

              type: string

              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'

              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized last name and the postcode joined by '|'. Every owner that
                shares a last name and postcode therefore carries the same value, with
                no opt-in required. Null for owners created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true

              title: Namesake count
              description: >-

                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3, computed at
                creation time: it starts at 1, gains 1 when the owner has an email
                address, gains 1 when the owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), and

              type: integer

              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the customer code: its '<REGION>'

              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-

                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

              description: >-

                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:

                duplicate detection, formatted '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>

                when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-

              type: integer

              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true

## Change

The spec requires `telephoneDisplay` — the stored E.164 `telephone` formatted for humans (country code, space, national digits grouped in threes, e.g. `+61412345678` → `+61 412 345 678`), while `telephone` stays raw E.164.

Following the repo's established pattern (derived read-only owner fields like `displayName`, `initials`, `membershipNumber` are `@Transient` getters on `Owner` that MapStruct auto-maps to a read-only OpenAPI property), I made two edits:

1. **`src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`** — added a `@Transient getTelephoneDisplay()`:
   - Returns `null` when there's no telephone, and returns the value unchanged if it isn't a `+`-prefixed E.164 string.
   - Splits off the country code using a prefix-free longest-match against known calling codes (`+61`, `+1`, matching the controller's `NATIONAL_NUMBER_LENGTHS`), falling back to a single leading digit for any unlisted code.
   - Emits `+<countryCode>` then the national digits grouped in threes, space-separated.
   - Added a `KNOWN_CALLING_CODES` constant to back it.

2. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a `telephoneDisplay` read-only string property to the `Owner` schema (alongside `displayName`/`initials`), so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and the mapper populates it automatically.

## Verification

- The new `AcceptanceTest.coreFormatsTelephoneDisplay` passes: input `0412 345 678` → `telephone = +61412345678`, `telephoneDisplay = +61 412 345 678`.
- Full `./mvnw -o test`: **BUILD SUCCESS**, all tests green.

No changes were needed to the mapper (auto-mapped by property name) or the controller (the field is purely derived from the already-stored E.164 telephone).
